author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: RFC3986 segment escaping is implemented in two helpers.
findings.consequence: Future changes to the escaping rule can diverge between validated route segments and general internal navigation segments, producing inconsistent canonical hrefs for the same characters.
findings.evidence: The owned unit performs encodeURIComponent(...).replace(/[!'()*]/g, ...) on lines 44-46. shared/utils/route-segment.ts also defines encodeValidatedRouteSegment with the same encodeURIComponent plus replace(/[!'()*]/gu, ...) policy on lines 16-20.
findings.recommendation: Extract the shared percent-escape step into one helper, then keep only the dot-segment and lone-surrogate policy in encodeRfc3986Segment and the validation assumptions in encodeValidatedRouteSegment.
verification: Inspected direct usages with rg for encodeRfc3986Segment and internal-navigation imports.
Inspected app/lib/internal-navigation.ts, app/lib/presentation-routes.ts, shared/utils/text-safety.ts, shared/utils/route-segment.ts, package.json, and relevant caller references.
No tests were executed because the review contract requested read-only inspection commands.
